info.title: Bangladesh Medicine Price Database — Public API
info.description: Read-only REST-style API over the crawled Arogga catalogue. In this static build the API is served as JSON files (no query parameters); the schema below documents every generated file. Point a server (Next.js route handlers, Express, etc.) at the same dataset to unlock query parameters — the item schema stays identical.

get.summary: Offers index (page links, sorted by discount)
All pharmaceutical companies with product counts

x-search-note: Full-text search runs client-side over the postings index (web/assets/js/db/index.js). A server-backed /api/v1/search can reuse the same index format.
